summary.en: The card outline morphs into a hexagon, three accent lines re-read it as a cube, the faces take three tones; a caption rises and three counted face labels hang off the cube.
summary.zh: 卡片轮廓变成六边形，三条强调色线把它重读成立方体，三个面上三种墨色；左侧说明升起，三个带计数的面标签挂在立方体上。

fits: The turn of a promotion: one flat thing revealed as a solid source (a spec, a schema, a model).
notFor: Films without a flat object before it; more than three counts.

intent.en: A flat thing is revealed as a solid source, so the viewer understands that everything else is generated from it.
intent.zh: 平面的东西被揭示为一个立体的源头，观众明白其余一切都是从它生成的。

content.en: A caption (≤ 15 chars / 7 字) and up to three counted face labels (≤ 15 / 8 字, may use {endpoints} {schemas} {sdks}).
content.zh: 一行说明（≤ 15 字符 / 7 字）和最多三个带计数的面标签（≤ 15 / 8 字，可用 {endpoints} {schemas} {sdks}）。

fits.zh: 升级片的转折：一个平面的东西揭示为立体的源头（规格、模式、模型）。

notFor.zh: 之前没有平面对象的片；超过三个计数。

en: The caption is 86 px bold: Chinese holds seven characters at most.
zh: 说明是 86 px 粗体：中文最多七个字。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
